args.stdin: {"query": "SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_kinds pk ON pv.product_kind_id = pk.product_kind_id JOIN product_families pf ON pv.product_family_id = pf.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pv.product_sku = pvp.product_sku WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pk.product_kind_name = :product_kind_name AND pf.product_family_name = :product_family_name AND pvp.property_key = :property_key AND pvp.property_value_text = :property_value LIMIT 1", "params": {"brand": "Fiskars", "product_kind_name": "Chainsaw", "product_family_name": "Fiskars Battery X 1CD-A3X Chainsaw", "property_key": "power source", "property_value": "petrol"}}
